mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_history (id, logindate) VALUES (#{id}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM login_history GROUP BY id HAVING MAX(logindate) < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET active = 'OFF' WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM login_history GROUP BY id HAVING MAX(logindate) < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, pw, email, active FROM member
SELECT email FROM member WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET active = 'ON' WHERE id = #{id} AND active = 'OFF'
UPDATE member SET active = CASE WHEN active = 'ON' THEN 'OFF' WHEN active = 'OFF' THEN 'ON' ELSE 'ON' END WHERE id = #{id}
